unknownRanges.method: Ranges derived around the published 16:27 spring boundary; expected sides determined by comparison, no fabricated birth time

solar.method: Synthetic 15-degree perturbation on an official calendar date, NOAA time_offset equation implies exactly 60 solar minutes for the same UTC instant

ages.method: Gregorian dates/leap-day existence cross-check; age arithmetic and March-1 rule fixed by task card, not claimed as an almanac age entry

historicalAndFractionalDst.method: Synthetic clock probes on official calendar dates; civil/standard offsets cross-checked against IANA historical rules; JDN/five-rat expected day/hour independent of library

actualCitiesSolar.method: Selected GeoNames city coordinates; 4 minutes per degree and EOT put Xining in 午 and Beijing in 未 at this clock minute

historicalStandardRegressions.method: Official Gregorian calendar dates + IANA STDOFF/SAVE; independent five-rat rule. Expectations never copied from the implementation.
